name: Seal Row
instructions: Lie face down on a high bench so the barbell hangs below you with your arms fully extended, and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Row the bar up to the underside of the bench by pulling your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the bar under control to full arm extension. The bench removes lower back involvement.
image_prompt_scene: Lying face down on a high bench with the barbell hanging below and the arms extended.
